info.value: bolanA, kahanA, prakASita honA, camakanA, tarka karanA, kalpanA karanA, vAda karanA, SaMkA karanA

examples: 'idamidamiti tatra tatra tattat svaparamatErgahana pratarkayadBiH' (BA॰SAM॰179.35). pratarkadBirvivfRvadBiH.
'kiM nu svidetat patatIti sarve vitarkayantaH parimohitAH smaH' (BA0 ).
'manoraTEScEva tu cintayAmi taTEva budDyA paritarkayAmi' (rA0 5.30.18). dAkziRAtyAstu manoraTaH syAditi cintayAmi taTApi budDyApi vitarkayAmi ityevaM 5.32.13 ityatra paWanti.
'na hyahaM taM kapiM manye karmaRA paritarkayan' (rA0 5.46.6). rAvaRasyoktirezA. paritarkayan anumimAnaH. UhamAnaH. juza paritarkaRe iti DAtupAWaH. paritarkaRamUho hiMsA veti dIkzitaH.
'kaccinna tarkayuktA vA ye cApyaparitarkitAH. tvayA vA tava vA'mAtyE rbADyante tAta mAnavAH' (rA0 gore0 2.109.16).. aparitarkitA nyAyato'parIkzitAH.
